statements.status_notes: The vulnerability in GHSA-cq8v-f236-94qc affects rand::rng(), an API introduced in rand 0.9.0. rand@0.8.5 does not contain this function and is not affected. The affected ranges are >=0.9.0,<0.9.3 and >=0.10.0,<0.10.1 only.
